play.name: Play
play.text: Plays all songs together from the green line, exactly as the final mix will sound.

pause.name: Pause
pause.text: Stops the sound where it is. Press Play to continue from the same spot.

stop.name: Stop
stop.text: Stops playing and jumps back to the very beginning.

undo.name: Undo
undo.text: Takes back your last change. Press it again to go back further.

redo.name: Redo
redo.text: Brings back a change you have just undone.

zoom-out.name: Zoom out
zoom-out.text: Shrinks the timeline so you can see more of the songs at once.

zoom-slider.name: Zoom
zoom-slider.text: Drag to make the timeline bigger or smaller. Left shows everything, right shows the finest detail. You can also turn the mouse wheel over the songs.

zoom-in.name: Zoom in
zoom-in.text: Enlarges the timeline so you can place cuts and edges precisely.

zoom-fit.name: Fit to window
zoom-fit.text: Makes everything you have added fit exactly into the window.

snap-off.name: Free
snap-off.text: Clips move smoothly and stay exactly where you drop them.

snap-beat.name: Beat
snap-beat.text: Clips jump to the nearest beat of the music, so songs stay in rhythm.

snap-bar.name: Bar
snap-bar.text: Clips jump to the start of the nearest bar (four beats). The easiest way to line songs up.

clear.name: Clear all
clear.text: Removes every song from the editor. Undo brings them back. Your Library is not touched.

export.name: Export
export.text: Saves the finished mix as one new song in your Library.

tab-songs.name: Songs
tab-songs.text: Choose songs to add: from your Library, from a playlist or from an online search.

tab-edit.name: Edit
tab-edit.text: Change the selected song: speed, effects, volume, fades and blending.

songs-library.name: Library
songs-library.text: Shows all the songs you already have in TON.

songs-playlists.name: Playlists
songs-playlists.text: Pick songs from one of your playlists.

songs-search.name: Search
songs-search.text: Finds songs online. A song added from here is only kept temporarily and never lands in your Library.

songs-filter.name: Filter
songs-filter.text: Type part of a title or an artist to narrow down the list.

lane-mute.name: Mute
lane-mute.text: Silences this song without removing it. Click again to hear it.

lane-solo.name: Solo
lane-solo.text: Plays only this song so you can hear it alone. Click again to hear everything.

lane-remove.name: Remove song
lane-remove.text: Takes this song out of the editor. The copy in your Library stays untouched.

clip-split.name: Cut here
clip-split.text: Cuts the selected clip in two at the green line, so you can delete or move one part.

clip-join.name: Connect
clip-join.text: Joins the selected piece back to the rest of its song so it plays without a gap, the opposite of cutting. A piece of another song is moved right after the clip before it.

clip-duplicate.name: Copy
clip-duplicate.text: Makes a second copy of the selected clip right behind it.

clip-delete.name: Delete
clip-delete.text: Removes the selected clip from the timeline.

look-slowed.name: Slowed
look-slowed.text: Plays the song slower, which also makes it deeper, like a slowed-down record.

look-slowed-reverb.name: Slowed + reverb
look-slowed-reverb.text: Slows the song down and adds a dreamy echo of a big room. The popular 'slowed and reverb' sound.

look-sped-up.name: Sped up
look-sped-up.text: Plays the song faster and higher, like a fast-forwarded record.

look-bass-boost.name: Bass boost
look-bass-boost.text: Makes the low, thumping sounds louder.

look-muffled.name: Muffled
look-muffled.text: Makes the song sound as if it were playing behind a wall, by cutting the high sounds.

look-reset.name: Reset song
look-reset.text: Puts speed, effects and tone of this song back to normal. Your cuts and fades stay.

speed.name: Speed
speed.text: How fast the clip plays. 1.00× is normal, lower is slower and deeper, higher is faster.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.text: Makes the clip higher or lower in small steps called semitones. 12 steps is one full octave.

keep-pitch.name: Keep pitch
keep-pitch.text: When you change the speed, keeps the voice and the notes the same instead of making them deeper or higher.

match-tempo.name: Match tempo
match-tempo.text: Changes the speed so this song has the same beats per minute as the first song, which makes mixing easier.

clip-volume.name: Clip volume
clip-volume.text: Makes just the selected clip quieter or louder.

lane-volume.name: Song volume
lane-volume.text: The volume of the whole song on this line.

balance.name: Left / right
balance.text: Moves the sound between your left and your right speaker.

bass.name: Bass
bass.text: Turns the low sounds up or down.

treble.name: Treble
treble.text: Turns the high, bright sounds up or down.

reverb.name: Reverb
reverb.text: Adds an echo like in a big hall. More of it makes the song sound far away and dreamy.

reverb-size.name: Room size
reverb-size.text: How big the imaginary room is. Bigger rooms echo for longer.

reverb-dark.name: Soft tail
reverb-dark.text: Makes the echo duller and warmer instead of bright and sharp.

echo.name: Echo
echo.text: Repeats the sound a moment later, like shouting in the mountains.

echo-time.name: Echo delay
echo-time.text: How long to wait before each repeat.

echo-repeats.name: Echo repeats
echo-repeats.text: How many times the echo repeats before it fades away.

filter-off.name: No filter
filter-off.text: Plays the song with all of its sounds.

filter-low.name: Cut highs
filter-low.text: Removes the high sounds, so the song sounds muffled and far away.

filter-high.name: Cut lows
filter-high.text: Removes the deep sounds, so the song sounds thin, like from a tiny speaker.

filter-freq.name: Filter strength
filter-freq.text: Where the cut starts. Move it until the song sounds the way you like.

fade-in.name: Fade in
fade-in.text: How long the clip takes to go from silent to full volume at its start.

fade-out.name: Fade out
fade-out.text: How long the clip takes to go from full volume to silent at its end.

transition-bars-2.name: 2 bars
transition-bars-2.text: A short blend: the two songs overlap for 2 bars of music.

transition-bars-4.name: 4 bars
transition-bars-4.text: A medium blend: the two songs overlap for 4 bars of music.

transition-bars-8.name: 8 bars
transition-bars-8.text: A smooth, long blend: the two songs overlap for 8 bars. The most common length for DJs.

transition-bars-16.name: 16 bars
transition-bars-16.text: A very slow blend: the two songs overlap for 16 bars.

curve-smooth.name: Smooth
curve-smooth.text: The songs swap places so the loudness stays even. Best for most mixes.

curve-straight.name: Straight
curve-straight.text: One song fades out while the other fades in, both at the same steady speed.

curve-slow.name: Slow start
curve-slow.text: The new song creeps in quietly and gets loud near the end.

transition-apply.name: Crossfade
transition-apply.text: Overlaps the selected clip with the song next to it and blends them using the length and style chosen above.

editEmpty: Click a song on the timeline to edit it.
editLaneOnly: Click a clip on this line to change its speed and fades.
emptyText: Your songs are in the panel on the right. Click a song there to put it here. Then you can cut it, slow it down, add effects and export the result.
downloadFailed: A download failed. Try another result.
exportText: The finished mix is saved as a new song in your Library.
clearText: All songs are removed from the editor. You can bring them back with Undo. Your Library and exported mixes are not touched.
removeConfirmText: Remove this song from the editor? Your Library stays untouched.
